title: SHOCK ABSORBER, UPR CONT ARM BUMPER & FRT SPRING CHART
summary: Front shock absorber (inside the front coil spring) and the upper control arm bumper (rubber rebound/jounce stop). The shock's top stud goes up through the frame spring tower with a retainer and rubber grommet on each side and a nut on top; the bottom mount bolts to the lower control arm with screws into weld nuts. The front spring itself is listed in UPC 0.

parts.name: RETAINER
parts.name_expanded: Retainer (washer), shock upper mount, above grommet

parts.name: RETAINER
parts.name_expanded: Retainer (washer), shock upper mount, below grommet

fastening.to: frame spring tower (top of front spring pocket)
fastening.note: Shock [5] upper stud goes up through the frame: retainer [7] and grommet [8] under the frame, grommet [3] and retainer [2] on top, nut [1] on the stud. Hold the stud at its flats to stop rotation while torquing.
Shock [5] lower mount bracket bolts up from below into weld nuts on the lower control arm with screw assemblies [6]; one screw shown on each side of the mount.

notes: Hold stud at this point when necessary to stop rotation & obtain torque.
End of coil must be .38 ± .12 from stop.
Front spring (see UPC 0). Assemble front spring with close spaced coils toward frame spring tower.
